sections.name: htmlToText
sections.title: HTML to plain text
sections.what: Removes scripts, styles, navigation, headers, and footers, turns block tags into line breaks, decodes common entities, and tidies spacing.
sections.why: Makes web pages readable for the AI.
sections.watch_out: Only a few HTML entities are decoded, so others may show as raw codes.

sections.name: POST (part 1)
sections.title: Check URL and fetch page
sections.what: Checks the address, tries Exa for LinkedIn when a key is present, then fetches the page with a browser-like header.
sections.why: Some sites block plain requests, and Exa is a fallback for LinkedIn.
sections.watch_out: No address check is applied before the fetch. See the risks above.

sections.name: POST: if
sections.title: Handle the fetched page
sections.what: Handles blocked or failed pages, reads LinkedIn job descriptions from structured data when present, and returns up to 8000 characters of text.
sections.why: Gives clear messages and keeps the AI input size reasonable.
sections.watch_out: A broken structured data block is skipped silently and the page text is used instead.

summary: Fetches a web page from an address and turns it into plain text, with special handling for LinkedIn job pages.
purpose: Lets users paste a job link instead of copying the job text.
why: Likely reason: saves copy and paste work.
how: Checks the address, tries Exa first for LinkedIn if a key is given, otherwise fetches the page directly with a browser-like header. For LinkedIn it looks for the job description in structured data. It converts HTML to text and caps the result at 8000 characters.
inputs: A URL and an optional Exa key.
outputs: Page text, the source used, or an error with status 400, 422, or 500.
risks: The server fetches any address it is given, including addresses on the internal network, which is a server-side request forgery risk. Nothing blocks private or local addresses.
debug: A 422 means the page blocked the request or was too short, so the user should paste the text. For LinkedIn failures, check the Exa key.
